name: fairway
description: Private web editor for the Caddyfile with validate-and-hot-reload

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix web run build && rm -rf dist/web && mkdir -p dist && cp -R web/dist dist/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.dev:reset: docker compose -f dev/compose.yaml down -v && rm -rf dev/run
